name: Change a pinned document under a live capsule (freeze_v3)
notes: governance-v7 pins docs/glossary.md by sha256. Before freeze_v3 (the-full-stack hardening 6.4) nothing compared a pinned hash with its document: governance-v2..v6 pinned a glossary hash that never matched, and datacube-v1 / hal-v1 outlived a two-line edit of their documents.
